hypotheses.justification: T2Space G follows from IsTopologicalGroup G together with TotallyDisconnectedSpace G, so it can be deleted. The statement does not need it to elaborate: FiniteGroupPresentation G needs only Group and TopologicalSpace, and CompactSpace and TotallyDisconnectedSpace need no separation axiom. The forward direction never uses it, because it only transports compactness and total disconnectedness along the homeomorphism P.equiv. The backward direction used it only for `ProfiniteGrp.of G`. After deleting the binder, derive it from the other hypotheses. Total disconnectedness gives connectedComponent (1:G) = {1} (`connectedComponent_eq_singleton`), and `isClosed_connectedComponent` makes this set closed, so `{1}` is closed. Then `IsTopologicalGroup.t2Space_iff_one_closed` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/Pointwise.lean) gives T2Space G. Alternatively, use `IsTopologicalGroup.t1Space G h` and the fact that topological groups are regular, `IsTopologicalGroup.regularSpace`. With `have : T2Space G := ...` in scope, the existing `ProfiniteGrp.of G` call and the rest of the proof go through unchanged.
